author: XtraMajestical
body:
So ive started a map called defenders vs Attackers and its DTM Where there's a castle where the defenders defend the monuments ,and there will be a cave where the attackers come out from. The attackers will have the under hand because they will have no monument so they will be a tiny bit more geared out than defenders! I need help on deciding where i should put the monument and how many monuments. So could i have feedback on where to put the monuments and how many monuments. The maps only just started so it will be improved massively according to the feedback i get! For the defenders to win there will be a 10 min count down for the monument to still be there!
Thanks please leave feedback Map Devs and normal players on what you think!

Heres a link
http://imgur.com/HZhGKe3

replies.author: Vobaseball12
replies.body:
Pictures?

I would think of a better name instead of 'Attackers vs. Defenders'. Something that goes with the map, like 'Medieval Defense' or something like that.

Edit: The castle looks a bit bland to me. Try add details, like flowing waterfalls, or mossy cobble stone to give it that "old" look. For some inspiration, Google medieval castles or something.
